skill.name: source-every-fact
skill.description: Load before writing, designing, approving or sending any customer-facing piece that carries hard facts: a post, story, reel, ad, flyer, caption, web page, proposal or chat reply that states a price, discount, phone or WhatsApp number, name, address, hours, date, shipping or payment terms, quantity, or a product claim. Use it for "check the prices", "is that the right number", "where did you get that", "¿de dónde sacas eso?", "ese no es el número", "ese precio no es", "no pongas mi nombre", "revisa los datos", "que no diga eso". It builds a fact sheet where every fact has a source, puts only those facts on the piece, adds nothing the source did not say, reads each fact back the way a customer would read it, and checks phones digit by digit. Not for choosing the design, writing the hook, or checking whether a post went live (use published-vs-planned).
skill.summary: Check customer-facing facts against dated sources, compare contact details character by character, and report unsupported claims before delivery.
skill.author: rabbitdesigns22

content.user_title: Verify Every Customer-Facing Fact Against Its Source
content.value_statement: Unsupported prices, contact details, and conditions can damage client trust. This skill guides source-based fact checks and produces a comparison table before delivery.
actual_capabilities: Build a fact sheet with exact values, sources, source dates, and confirmation details.
Identify missing sources and collect questions for the client in one message.
Remove unsupported conditions, calculated discounts, and unwanted personal names.
Review number spacing, currency, units, dates, hours, and contact-channel consistency.
Guide character-level checks of prices and contact details, browser link checks, and inspection of exported image text.
Produce a delivery table showing each fact, its source, and its verification status.
limitations: Matching a source does not prove that the source is accurate.
Browser checks and exported image inspection require appropriate tool access and available files.
The skill does not choose designs, write promotional hooks, or confirm publication status.
Legal and medical claims require separate policy checks and professional review where needed.

use_cases.title: Review promotional captions
use_cases.description: Compare prices, discounts, and contact details against current client materials before scheduling a campaign.

use_cases.title: Approve exported artwork
use_cases.description: Check visible phone numbers, prices, dates, and units against the fact sheet before delivering a finished flyer.

use_cases.title: Check customer replies
use_cases.description: Confirm payment terms, shipping statements, and business hours against dated sources before sending a customer response.

prompt_templates.title: Beginner: Check a short caption
prompt_templates.prompt: Check this caption against the supplied client message: [caption] [message]. List supported facts and ask for any missing sources.
prompt_templates.scenario: A first factual review of a short customer-facing message.

prompt_templates.title: Intermediate: Build a client fact sheet
prompt_templates.prompt: Build a fact sheet from these dated client materials: [materials]. Include exact values, sources, dates, and confirmation details. Flag contradictions without choosing a value.
prompt_templates.scenario: Preparing source records before writing or designing a new piece.

prompt_templates.title: Advanced: Review an exported flyer
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this exported flyer, caption, and contact link against the supplied sources: [files and sources]. Compare contact details character by character. Report unavailable checks explicitly.
prompt_templates.scenario: Checking consistency across visual content, copy, and contact links.

prompt_templates.title: Expert: Resolve a correction across versions
prompt_templates.prompt: Use this dated client correction to audit the supplied campaign versions: [correction and versions]. Identify affected facts, propose corrections, and retire outdated fact-sheet values.
prompt_templates.scenario: Coordinating a factual correction across supplied campaign materials.

output_examples.input: Example source: client message dated 8 November lists MX$700. Draft caption: MX$700, shipping extra. No shipping terms were supplied.
output: Fact: price. On the piece: MX$700. Source: client message dated 8 November. Match: verified against the supplied message.
Fact: shipping extra. Source: none supplied. Action: remove the unsupported condition.
Question for the client: What shipping terms should appear, if any?

output_examples.input: Example source: brand contact sheet lists 555 010 2040. Draft caption lists 555 010 2400. No contact link was provided.
output: Fact: phone number. Draft: 555 010 2400. Source: brand contact sheet, 555 010 2040. Match: no.
Both values contain 10 digits, but the final four digits differ. Replace the draft number with 555 010 2040.
Contact link: not verified because no link was supplied.

best_practices: Provide dated client messages and current reference materials before requesting a review.
Supply exported images, captions, and links so each customer-visible version can be checked.
Keep one dated fact sheet per client and mark replaced values as retired.
anti_patterns: Filling missing facts from memory, competitor materials, or typical industry values.
Adding shipping conditions, stock claims, or calculated discounts without explicit source support.
Calling a fact verified when it was not checked against its source during the current review.

faq.question: Does this skill prove that a claim is true?
faq.answer: No. It checks whether content matches the supplied source. Incorrect source material can still produce incorrect content.

faq.question: What happens when a fact has no source?
faq.answer: The workflow pauses and groups missing facts into one request. Unsupported facts should not appear in the piece.

faq.question: Which sources should I provide?
faq.answer: Provide current client instructions and materials. Previously approved pieces are secondary sources only when newer materials do not contradict them.

faq.question: Can it check phone numbers in images?
faq.answer: The workflow requires checking the exported image, not just the design source. Actual inspection depends on available files and image access.

faq.question: Will it open contact links?
faq.answer: The skill instructs the assistant to open links and confirm their destinations. Browser access is required; unavailable checks must remain unverified.

faq.question: Does it handle legal approval or publication tracking?
faq.answer: No. Legal and medical claims need separate review. The skill does not confirm whether content was published.
